name: DarknessCon: Denver
blurb: Denver-area stop of the touring DarknessCon horror convention, with celebrity guests, cosplay and a Dark Harvest Masquerade Ball at The Castle Event Center.

editions.evidence: Denver page text/title: 'DarknessCon Denver — October 31, 2026' / 'OCTOBER 31, 2026 DENVER THE CASTLE EVENT CENTER'

notes: DarknessCon is a touring horror-convention brand (one shared darknesscon.com site with a per-city page for Snake River, Denver, Reno, Boise, Salt Lake City, plus Albuquerque/Jacksonville/New Orleans/Omaha/Portland 'coming 2027'). Only Denver, Snake River and Salt Lake City were in this research batch; Reno and Boise are separate editions of the same brand not assigned here. Denver's special-guests section lists only one named guest (Mythica Blessyng) plus a 'To Be Announced' placeholder tile, which was skipped. 2026-10-06 refresh: unchanged; the one new card (#4) is a floor-plan placeholder, not a guest.
